newsitem.title: USA: Material Sciences sees better second-half results.
newsitem.headline: Material Sciences sees better second-half results.

text.p: Material Sciences Corp, which reported higher sales and earnings for the second quarter ended August 31, said Monday it expects year-to-year improvement in its results for the second half.

Material Sciences reported earnings for the second quarter of $0.29 a share, up from $0.26 a year ago. For the first half, it earned $0.59 a share on net sales of $139.3 million, up from earnings of $0.58 on sales of $119.1 million.
"We are encouraged by our record sales and earnings through the first six months and remain optimistic about the balance of the year," G. Robert Evans, chairman, said.

He said laminates and composites should continue to show good year-to-year comparisons, based on increasing adoption of the company's noise-reducing and thermal control materials in current and new markets.

"The specialty films group should continue to benefit from its acquisition of Solar Gard and a former West Coast distributor and from the new product and market development initiatives currently in place," Evans said.
He said coil coating is expected to profit from improved operating efficiencies and a new coil coating line due to come on stream later this fiscal year.

"Finally, in the case of electrogalvanizing, we currently are running ahead of last year's record pace in sales and tons shipped, and are optimistic about maintaining this lead for the year as a whole," Evans said.
